description:
Liveness and capability check for yieldsentinel (yieldsentinel.eth).

Returns service status, package version, health schemaVersion (separate from the tool-envelope schemaVersion), policyVersion, feature flags, and the list of available tools.

toolStats counts all origins. toolStatsExternal is the external bucket. toolStatsInternal is the internal-test bucket. Send header X-YHYS-Test: 1 on every request (initialize, notifications, and each tools/call). On this stateless server that header is the only working internal-test marker. clientInfo.name prefixes yhys-qa / yhys-feel count only for the same request they appear in.

May refresh research vintage via a yieldhunter health ping; a verdict still requires check_position. YH healthy ≠ YS ok.

Use this first to verify connectivity, then call check_position with policyPreset treasury-conservative | balanced-research | rwa-selective (or explicit thresholds). Research estimates only — non-custodial; never holds keys or executes transactions.

Example input: {}
name: health
title: Health
